title: feat(types,layout): a `doc` nav entry validates and draws as a link into the docs portal (objectui#11197)
body:
Fixes #11197 — the acceptance, the rendering, the portal's book-name resolution (option A, the seat's answer on the card, comment 5910896132) and every pin the card, the claim and that answer name.
Clause-②: no

## What changed

**`@object-ui/types`**
- `NavigationItemTypeSchema` is read off the discriminator of `@objectstack/spec`'s navigation union at module load (the `AppSchema.navigation` walk this file already used for the separator's keys, now shared). It gains `doc`, and the next spec type flows in with no edit here.
- A `doc` entry is judged by its own arm, routed by a discriminated union on `type`. That arm hands the entry WHOLE to the spec's own `DocNavItemSchema` and raises each issue it answers, so it accepts nothing the spec's `doc` arm refuses: the one-target rule, the doc-name shape, the non-empty `book`, the snake_case `id` and the closed key set are the spec's words, chained and never copied. The arm passes unknown keys through to that judge instead of stripping them, so nothing unknown survives a successful parse. The judge's OUTPUT is never used (the spec's parse turns a `visible` string into an expression envelope; this validator writes no value into an author's document). An empty `label` is refused as on every sibling.
- The TypeScript face: `NavigationEntryItem` gains `book` and `doc`, derived from the spec's `DocNavItem`.
- An unknown `type` is now refused with `invalid_union` at `type` (was `invalid_value`) — the code the spec's own union answers with. The message still lists the expected types.

**`@object-ui/layout`**
- `resolveHref` sends a `doc` entry to the console docs portal under its `basePath`, using the portal's own two route shapes: `{ doc }` to `.../docs/DOC` (the flat-doc permalink, which redirects to the doc's canonical in-book URL), `{ book }` to `.../docs/BOOK` (the book landing), both to `.../docs/BOOK/DOC`. In an app `basePath` is `/apps/PACKAGE_ID`, the package-container docs tree `AppHeader`'s "This app's docs" entry already opens; on home navigation it is the top-level `/docs` portal.
- An unlabelled `doc` entry shows the page it opens, else the book (the machine-name rung every non-inheriting type uses).
- The mobile tab bar delegates a `doc` entry to `resolveHref` instead of drawing `#`.
- Gating is the base keys every sibling carries (`visible`, `requiredPermissions`, `requiresObject`, `requiresService`) through the existing guard. No client-side audience: the book audience gate stays the server's read layer (ADR-0046 section 6.7).

**`@object-ui/plugin-designer`** — `NAV_TYPE_META` drops the `| 'doc'` key that bridged the pin lag, as its own comment asked at the pin that ships `doc`.

**`@object-ui/app-shell`** — the app designer's preview keyed its kinds by a hand list of nine, so a label-less `doc` entry was DROPPED from the read-only preview and the design canvas badged a spec-valid `doc` entry in the amber `untyped` tone. The kind set is now a `Record` keyed by the spec-derived `NavigationItemType` (a spec addition stops it compiling), and a `doc` entry draws with its target, its route and its own tone. It is never picked as the landing, matching the runtime's `findFirstRoute`.

**`@object-ui/console`** — the docs portal resolves a path segment that is a book's NAME (and no book's slug) to that book and redirects, replace, to the canonical `base/bookSlug(book)[/DOC]` URL. See the option-A section below.

**Docs** — `content/docs/guide/designing-app-navigation.md` teaches the `doc` entry and says to name a book by its `name`. **Changeset** — `minor` for the five packages.

## Measured: which portal URLs resolve (item 3)

A throwaway integration run (not committed) mounted the real `DocsLayout` / `AppDocsIndex` / `DocsSlug` / `DocPage` under `/apps/:appName/docs` with a mocked adapter serving an authored book `showcase_manual` with `slug: 'manual'` (the shape of the one authored book in objectstack's examples) plus a package with no authored book.

| entry | href this PR draws | where the portal lands |
|---|---|---|
| `{ doc: 'showcase_lead_guide' }` | `.../docs/showcase_lead_guide` | redirects to `.../docs/manual/showcase_lead_guide`: doc content and book sidebar |
| `{ book: 'showcase_manual' }` (slug `manual`) | `.../docs/showcase_manual` | "Documentation not found" |
| control: `.../docs/manual` | — | book landing, then the first doc with sidebar |
| `{ book: 'showcase_manual', doc: 'showcase_lead_guide' }` | `.../docs/showcase_manual/showcase_lead_guide` | doc content renders; no book sidebar |
| `{ book: 'com.example.ops' }` (implicit book) | `.../docs/com.example.ops` | book landing, then its doc |
| `{ book: 'com.example.ops', doc: 'ops_setup' }` | `.../docs/com.example.ops/ops_setup` | doc content |

So, before option A: a `doc` target always resolved, and so did a `book` target whose portal slug equals its name (every implicit package book, every authored book without a `slug`). A book that authors a different `slug` was reached by neither `book` shape: the console addresses books by `slug`, the spec's nav target names the book's `name`. Option A closes that below.

## Option A — the portal resolves a book NAME

`book-nav.ts` gains `bookNamedBy(segment, books)`: the book whose `name` is the segment, `null` when the segment is some book's slug. `DocsSlug` and `DocPage` redirect a hit, replace, to `base/bookSlug(book)` and `base/bookSlug(book)/DOC` — the same `Navigate replace` the portal already uses for a flat-doc permalink. The renderer's href is unchanged.

**The invariant: no URL that resolves today changes its answer.** The precedence was measured first, with the new pins run against the UNMODIFIED portal: 5 red (the name cases), 14 green (the 6 existing portal tests, 3 collision pins, 5 controls). Today's answers for the red five: `/docs/showcase_manual` and its app-scoped twin stayed put on "Documentation not found"; `/docs/showcase_manual/showcase_lead_guide` and its twin rendered the doc in place with no book sidebar; `/docs/acme_manual` was caught by the name-prefix fallback and redirected to `/docs/acme-docs/acme_manual`, where the reader answered "Documentation not found".

So the name lookup runs AFTER a book's slug and an installed doc's name, and BEFORE the name-prefix fallback, whose redirect for a name no installed doc carries lands on "not found". In `DocPage` it runs only for a `:slug` no book answers by slug. The one former answer that is not a "not found" and still moves is the reader at `.../docs/NAME/DOC`: the same doc, now at its canonical URL with its book sidebar, which the seat's pins require.

Pins, in `apps/console/src/pages/docs-portal.test.tsx` (a second, authored-book world switched on only by the new block; the existing tests read the implicit-book world as before):
- name to book: `/docs/showcase_manual` lands on `/docs/manual/showcase_index`; `/docs/showcase_manual/showcase_lead_guide` lands on `/docs/manual/showcase_lead_guide` with the book sidebar marking it current; both again under `/apps/com.example.showcase/docs`; `/docs/acme_manual` (the prefix-fallback case) lands on `/docs/acme-docs/acme_intro`;
- collisions keep today's answer: `handbook` is `alpha_manual`'s slug and the name of the book whose slug is `beta` — `/docs/handbook` opens `alpha_manual` and `/docs/handbook/beta_start` stays put; `showcase_lead_guide` is both an installed doc and a book (slug `leads`) — `/docs/showcase_lead_guide` stays the doc permalink, `/docs/manual/showcase_lead_guide`;
- controls, one per shape that resolves today: a book slug, SLUG/DOC with sidebar, an implicit package book, an unknown reader segment (doc in place, no sidebar), and a segment naming nothing (still "not found").

Ablations (same tool and discipline as below, HEAD `c148d417b`, each restored blob == HEAD, tree clean after): P1 `DocsSlug`'s name lookup off — 3 of 19 red (the two NAME landings, the prefix-fallback case); P2 `DocPage`'s redirect off — 2 of 19 red (both NAME/DOC pins); P3 the name lookup moved ahead of the doc permalink — 1 of 19 red (the doc-and-book collision); P4 the prefix fallback moved ahead of the name lookup — 1 of 19 red (the prefix-fallback case).

## Consumers that switch on nav type (item 4)

- `NavigationRenderer` (sidebar), `nav:menu`, `UnifiedSidebar` (both arms), pinned entries, active-state matching: all route through `resolveHref` / `resolveNavItemLabel`, so they draw a `doc` entry with this change and needed no edit of their own.
- `AppSchemaRenderer` mobile tab bar: hand-rolled hrefs; now delegates `doc`.
- `AppPreview` / `AppNavCanvas` (metadata-admin preview): edited as above.
- `CommandPalette`: an allow-list of four in-app kinds (object, dashboard, page, report); `url`, `component` and `action` are absent too. Not a fall-through drop; unchanged, and no new i18n key.
- `findFirstRoute` (landing): lands on object / page / dashboard / report only; `component` is absent too. A `doc` entry is not a landing. Unchanged.
- `navSurface.resolveSurface` (Studio design rail): a `doc` entry has no design surface (docs are package markdown), so `null` is the right answer. Unchanged.
- `useNavPins`: type-agnostic. Unchanged.

## Pins and ablations

Pins: `packages/types/src/__tests__/navigation-spec-parity.test.ts` (new objectui#11197 blocks), `nav-label-optional-9868.test.ts` (the `doc` fixture its coverage assertion now demands), `packages/layout/src/__tests__/NavigationRenderer.docEntry-11197.test.tsx`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/AppPreview.docEntry-11197.test.tsx`.

Every ablation went through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (at `22e584c9db`; anchor must hit once, blob moved, restore proven blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty), each leg run at HEAD `9b3e0b658` (the round before option A) with the file under test resolving to source through the vitest alias:

| leg | mutation | red |
|---|---|---|
| A1 | the `doc` arm taken out of the union | 22 of 41 — every "parses on both faces" and every spec-reason refusal |
| A2 | the spec judge silenced | 10 of 41 — target-less, closed keys, boolean `visible`, id shape, remedy text, nested |
| A3 | the enum admits `'bogus'` | 2 of 41 — the unknown-type control and the discriminator pin |
| A4a | the enum put back as a hand list | first try was a NO-OP for the pin: a list without `doc` makes `.exclude(['doc'])` throw at module load, so no test ran. Redone with a hand list that drops `component`: 2 of 65 red (discriminator pin, the 9868 fixture-coverage pin) |
| A4b | `doc` dropped from the triaged-type tripwire | 1 of 41 — the tripwire |
| A5 | the `doc` branch of `resolveHref` deleted | 8 of 10 |
| A6 | the `doc` label rung deleted | 2 of 10 |
| A7 | `doc` taken out of the preview's kind set | 1 of 3 |

After all legs: `git diff HEAD` 0 bytes, `git status --porcelain` 0 lines.

## Gates (HEAD `c148d417b`)

- `pnpm --filter` type-check: `@object-ui/console` 0, `@object-ui/types` 0, `@object-ui/layout` 0, `@object-ui/app-shell` 0, `@object-ui/plugin-designer` 0 — after building the console's dependency closure (`turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/console^...`, 34 tasks). The console program lists `DocsSlug.tsx`, `DocPage.tsx`, `book-nav.ts` and `docs-portal.test.tsx`; each package's `tsconfig.test.json` lists its new pin file.
- From the repo root: `vitest run packages/types/ packages/layout/ packages/plugin-designer/ apps/console/src/pages/` plus 9 console tests that mention docs, 48 nav-related app-shell test files and `packages/cli/src/__tests__/validate-union-arm-selection.test.ts`: 450 files, 8241 tests passed, exit 0. `vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/`: 86 files, 1130 tests passed (previous round; untouched since).
- `check:control-bytes` 0, `check:new-line-citations` 0 (0 new), `check:spec-symbols` 0, `check:component-surface-parity` 0 (report-only), `check:changeset-claims` 0 (7 pending changesets name a touched file; each paragraph re-read, none falsified), `check:doc-types` 0, `check:docs-route-closure` 0, `check:vi-mock-specifiers` / `-inherit` / `-override-shape` 0, `check:test-path-roots` 0, `check-changeset-presence` 0 (15 source files of 5 released packages, 1 changeset), `check-changeset-no-major` 0.
- NOT MEASURED: the full app-shell suite (921 files; stopped at 12 minutes, exit 143 by my kill — declared narrowing to the 48 nav-related files, CI runs the rest); `check:spec-floors` and `check:readme-exports` (both need the whole workspace built); repo lint (CI-owned).
- The `Spec Main Shape Gate` red names `writeWarningToast.ts` and `spec-symbol-batch6.test.ts`, which this diff does not touch; objectui#11206 carries it, and the seat brings `main` in after it lands.

## Notes for review

- The TypeScript `NavigationEntryItem` is one flat interface, so `book` / `doc` are declared on every entry type, as `url` and `componentRef` already are. The runtime validator is the per-type door.
- Acceptance notes, not filed: `navSurface.ts`'s docblock still says "nine-member" union; the spec's `BookSchema.slug` description says it defaults to the name "sans prefix", while the console's `bookSlug` defaults to the full name (under option A the redirect goes to whatever `bookSlug` computes, so the two stay consistent).
- Report only, not in this PR: the mobile tab bar's hand-rolled hrefs for the other types were probed and disagree with `resolveHref` (record deep link, `filters`, `runAction`, `metadata:*`); the measured hrefs are in the dev report for the seat to file.
